basic_details.job_title: Mumbai Port Authority Financial Analyst Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Mumbai Port Authority has announced 3 vacancies for the Financial Analyst post on a contract basis, with completed offline applications required to be submitted on or before 10 November 2026. Applicants must possess the required qualification as a Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Qualified Cost & Management Accountant (CMA). The notified remuneration for the Financial Analyst position is Rs. 60,000 plus Rs. 15,000 transportation allowance, and the selection process consists of an interview. Eligible candidates should follow the offline application procedure specified in the official 2026

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) or Qualified Cost & Management Accountants (CMA). | Age Limit: The maximum age limit for the post is 30 years.

selection_process: The selection method is through an interview of the eligible candidates. The interview will be conducted before a panel comprising of two Officers from the Finance Department and one Officer from the GAD Department.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on a contract basis for a period of one year, extendable by another year at a time at the discretion of the port. Appointment is subject to candidates being found medically fit as per Mumbai Port Authority requirements and verification of police antecedents. Emergency medical treatment will be provided at MbPA Hospital/dispensary in case of accident while on duty; no other medical facilities are admissible. Leave entitlement consists of 12 days Casual Leave in a year and Public Holidays. Standard duty hours are from 10:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. for 5 days a week, with potential requirement to work beyond normal hours as needed. Accommodation at MbPA quarters may be provided subject to availability, with rent deducted as per rules along with consumption-based electricity and water charges. The contract can be terminated by either side by giving one month notice in writing.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Mumbai Port Authority Financial Analyst Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Financial Analyst post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date of receiving applications is 10.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be Qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) or Qualified Cost & Management Accountants (CMA).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Financial Analyst position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration offered to the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 60,000/- plus a transportation allowance of Rs. 15,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contract basis for a period of one year, which is extendable based on performance review.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection is made through an interview conducted by a panel comprising two officers from the Finance Department and one officer from the GAD Department.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any allowances paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: Apart from the specified Rs. 15,000/- transportation allowance, no other general allowances are mentioned, though emergency medical treatment on duty and optional MbPA quarter accommodation subject to availability are provided under specific terms.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose self-attested proof of date of birth, educational and professional qualification certificates, past employment experience documents, and any relevant proficiency or achievement certificates.
